content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 for missing prior authorization. This payer does not offer retroactive authorization and does not offer peer-to-peer review. The authorization was required and missing at time of service, so it cannot be obtained after the fact. However, an appeal with medical necessity is a legitimate avenue given a denial is on the table, and it can potentially overturn an auth-based denial. No self-service action fixes the missing auth, so appealing with necessity is the best available path to progress collection.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
